subject.title: feat(browser): My Browser node-anchored turn routing (stacks on #93411)

question: Should this PR be rebased/split to preserve unique side-panel and node-routed browser-copilot work on top of the current driver "extension" relay, or should maintainers close it as superseded by the merged and active browser-extension relay work?
rationale: Current main changed the browser-extension architecture after this branch was opened, and the remaining value crosses product UX, plugin API, config, dependency, and security boundaries that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Split onto current relay
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main, drop the duplicate extension driver/package/lockfile changes, and keep only the unique side-panel or node-turn pieces that still fit the current relay architecture.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR after linking the merged relay and active remote-gateway work if maintainers decide the side-panel/node-anchored approach is no longer wanted.

options.title: Pause for byNode direction
options.body: Keep the PR idle until maintainers decide whether the open byNode PR should land or be replaced by the current node-safe tool model.

recommendation.title: Split onto current relay
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main, drop the duplicate extension driver/package/lockfile changes, and keep only the unique side-panel or node-turn pieces that still fit the current relay architecture.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current-main browser extension relay and the active remote-gateway follow-up, so they are best positioned to decide the architecture fit.
